response.sql: WITH mix_counts AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, COUNT(*) AS behaviour_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), mix_shares AS (SELECT order_type_mix, behaviour_count, behaviour_count::numeric / SUM(behaviour_count) OVER () AS share FROM mix_counts), compared AS (SELECT order_type_mix, behaviour_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS baseline_share FROM mix_shares) SELECT order_type_mix, behaviour_count, share, share - baseline_share AS above_baseline FROM compared WHERE share > baseline_share
